div.p: AN ACT to amend an act entitled “An act to increase the import duties upon certain goods,” approved the 27th day of September, A. D. 1876.

p.hi: Be it enacted by the King and the Legislative Assembly of the Hawaiian Islands, in the Legislature of the Kingdom assembled:

list.item:
Section 1. That section 1 of an act to increase the import duties on certain goods, approved the 27th day of September, A. D. 1876, be and the same is hereby amended to read as follows:
Section 1. There shall be levied, collected, and paid upon the following goods imported into this kingdom, duties ad valorem as follows, to wit:
Silks, satins, and silk velvet, and all articles of which silk shall form the principal material, 10 per cent.
Clothing, ready made, and wearing apparel of every description, made up in whole or in part, 10 per cent.
Carriages of all descriptions, 10 per cent.
Hats and caps of all kinds, 10 per cent.
Linens, and all manufactures of which flax, grass-cloth, or a similar material shall form the principal part, 10 per cent.
Crockery and glass ware of every description, 10 per cent.
Drugs and medicines, patent and other, 10 per cent.
Furniture of all kinds, if upholstered or carved, manufactured in whole or in part, 10 per cent.
Millinery goods, beads, braids, bonnets, buttons, corsets, collars, sleeves and cuffs, edgings flowers (artificial), feathers (fancy), fringes for clothing and for upholstery, 10 per cent.
Gloves and mits, not otherwise provided for, 10 per cent.
Gimps for clothing, 10 per cent.
Hoop-skirts, 10 per cent.
Hooks and eyes, 10 per cent.
Insertions, laces, and lace goods of all descriptions, 10 per cent.
Ribbons, not otherwise provided for, 10 per cent.
Silver plate, plated ware, or gilt ware, 10 per cent.
Britannia ware and fancy metal ware, 10 per cent.
Tea, 10 per cent.
Matches of all kinds, 10 per cent.
Cigarettes, and all descriptions of paper cigars, 25 per cent.
Jewelry, and all descriptions of metal, glass, or stone beads, 10 per cent.
Paintings, pictures, engravings, statuary, bronzes, ornamental work of metal, stone, marble, plaster of Paris or alabaster, and all imitations thereof, 10 per cent.
Perfumery (other than that which pays a spirit duty), powders, hair, tooth, nail, and other toilet brushes, 10 per cent.
Soaps, 10 per cent.
Pipes (smoking), pipe-stems, bowls and fixtures, cigar-holders, 25 per cent.
Candles, 10 per cent.
Candies, 25 per cent.
Peanut oil, 25 per cent.
Toys, 10 per cent.
Fire-arms, 10 per cent.
Ammunition, 10 per cent.
Fire-works and fire-crackers, 25 per cent.
Watches and clocks, in whole or in part, 10 per cent.
Playing-cards, 10 per cent.

Sec. 2. That section 2 of the said act be, and the same is hereby, amended to read as follows:
Sec. 2. There shall be levied, collected, and paid upon the following goods imported into this kingdom, specific duties as follows, to wit:
On kid and all other leather and skin gloves, $3 per dozen pairs.
On cigars and cheroots, $10 per thousand.
On China tobacco, 50 cents per pound.
On camphor trunks, in nests of four, $2 per nest; and in nests of two, $1 per nest.
On China matting, $1 per roll.
On port, sherry, madeira, and other wines of like nature, above 18 per cent. of alcoholic strength; also, on all cordials, bitters, and other articles of any name or description containing alcohol or preserved in alcohol or spirits above that rate of Strength and below 30 per cent., unless otherwise provided for, $2 per gallon.
On champagne, sparkling Moselle, and sparkling Hock, $3 per dozen reputed quarts, and $1.50 per dozen reputed pints.
On claret, Rhine wine, and other light wines under 18 per cent. of alcoholic strength, not otherwise provided for, 40 cents per dozen reputed quarts, 20 cents per dozen for reputed pints, and 15 cents per gallon if in bulk.
On ale, porter, cider, and all fermented drinks, not otherwise provided for, 40 cents per dozen reputed quarts, 20 cents per dozen reputed pints, and 15 cents per gallon if in bulk.
Sec. 3. The provisions of this act shall extend and apply to all goods in bond at the time it shall come into operation.

closer.dateline: Approved this 1st day of August, A. D. 1878.
